prose:
Simon Willison quotes Ravi Vakil describing a separate proposed generalized Riemann proof by Alessandro Masullo and ongoing feedback from Brian Conrad. The passage says the work is human-authored and that a draft is being released earlier than previously intended.

A secondhand description of encouraging review is not final acceptance or evidence that every issue is resolved. The underlying draft and full announcement were not inspected here, and this proposed proof must remain distinct from Alpöge’s Claude-assisted claim.
highlights: Quotation concerns a separate proposed proof
Feedback and revision are ongoing in the account
Human-authored claim is attributed to the quoted speaker
Encouraging assessment is not final acceptance
